name: Data Sharing Check
description: Before Fontara shares data with a vendor or partner: the data's classification on page one; restricted data opens a second page for the impact assessment.

fields.label: Business owner
fields.description: The person accountable for this agreement after it is signed.

fields.label: Existing agreement
fields.description: The agreement the sharing falls under, if there is one: CLM ID or exact title.

fields.label: What personal data, about whom?
fields.description: Categories of data and of people, e.g. customer employees' names and work emails.

fields.text: Special-category or children's data needs a data protection impact assessment before signature. The Data Protection Officer (Alexandra Kim) will contact you.
